abilities.name: Help, Pix!
notes:
If the player casts Help, Pix! on a non-champion target, the spell script will first search for a targetable allied or enemy champion within 75 radius around the target. If there is at least one, it'll apply the effects to the closest one instead of the initial target.
  - Allies or enemies or proximity take priortity?
  - This effect does not respect that the champion may not be visible to Lulu and not a valid target for normal selection for this reason. Therefore it can for instance apply the effects to stealthed enemy champions this way.
  - Since the original cast did not target the champion, some effects (such as Guardian) may behave incorrectly.
  - It is not known in which patch this effect was added.
Spell shield and Riposte will block the damage but Pix will still follow regardless.

If there is at least one, it'll apply the effects to the closest one instead of the initial target.
** {{pending for test}} Allies or enemies or proximity take priortity?
** This effect does not respect that the champion may not be visible to '''Lulu''' and not a valid target for normal selection for this reason. Therefore it can for instance apply the effects to stealthed enemy champions this way.{{bug}}

abilities.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
notes: Pix's bolts do not fire alongside abilities that apply on-hit effects (e.g. Runaan's Hurricane).

The empowered attack does not trigger against structures nor wards.
  - Neither of them will intercept Pix's bolts.

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Pix, Faerie Companion|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lulu
|skill        = I
|icon         = Pix, Faerie Companion.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Lulu}} is assisted by '''Pix''', who follows her around. Whenever '''Lulu''' basic attacks, '''Pix''' fires 3 bolts that deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
|blurb2      = Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers '''Pix''' to them, to which he fires with their basic attacks.
|blurb3      = '''Pix''' snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she moves too far away.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lulu''' is assisted by ''Pix'', an {{tip|untargetable}} faerie, who follows her around and fires a barrage of 3 bolts towards her target whenever she uses a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}}. Each bolt deals {{as|{{pplevel|5 to 39}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it collides with, for a total of {{as|{{pplevel|5*3 to 39*3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} on hitting a single target with all three bolts.
|description2 = Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers ''Pix's'' help to them, causing him to fire the bolts dependent on their basic attacks.
|description3 = ''Pix snaps back to '''Lulu''' if she is too far away.''
|customlabel  = Leash Range
|custominfo   = {{dv|{{tt|1600|Pix' leash range when moving freely}}|{{tt|2050|Pix' leash range when on another unit, estimated}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|60|Bolt missile width}}
|speed        = {{tt|900 - 2600|Bolt missile speed, 5200 acceleration; reaching maximum speed within 0.33 seconds}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = proc
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = False
|notes        = 
* ''Pix's'' bolts do not fire alongside abilities that apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects (e.g. {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}).
* ''Pix'' does not fire if the target dies.
* ''Pix'' fires from his own location and not from the unit he is following.
* When on an ally champion, ''Pix's'' damage respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* The empowered attack does not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** Neither of them will intercept ''Pix's'' bolts.
